## Reminders (Google Sheets)
Runs every 15 min and reads the Bookings sheet. Sends ONE reminder ~24h before and ONE ~1h before. The reminder is only written to the 'Reminder Sent' column when the email really went out, so a failed email is retried on the next run. Canceled bookings are never reminded because the status is checked live. A moved booking is reminded again (the booking workflow clears the column).
